description: Land Title Settlement Department - Boralessa, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puththalam District - Cad. Map No. 410016
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and the registration of land titles under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content falls under land registrations and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
